Requirements You are not doomed

Effect You call upon your infernal pact to surge with devilish power. You gain a +2 status bonus to the next attack roll, skill check, or saving throw you attempt before the end of your next turn. You then become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Doomed]{Doomed 1}.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
